material.acceptance_criteria: With one relay returning 503, Fill with bots and Start match work and a bot-filled match starts.
material.description: Witness of the feedback re-check (verify-game-feedback-1): with relay.damus.io returning 503, Claim works but Fill with bots and Start match are disabled, so no match starts. A single relay outage should not disable the lobby, since the match needs only the sessions it has. This also blocks every in-game witness. The drain lane locates the lobby gating in scenarios/moba/panels.lua (lobby seats) and js/client/play.js (relay and join).

notes.note:
drain-lobby-relay-1-timing: live-site per-await timing, 5 sequential loads. Target https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html?host=1 (live version.json sha 11edb063; play.js line numbers match origin 4b24d0b, 3191 lines). 1280x720, cache disabled, real relay (no relay param), fresh isolated tab each load, CDP Debugger logpoints (breakpoint conditions that record performance.now and return false; no code change).
Load | main await | build3d total | splat await | unitFitsReady await | status at 15 s | relay (console)
C1 | 10380 | 10377 | 10214 | 0 | loading world assets | not captured
C2 | 10563 | 10558 | 10159 | 237 | loading world assets | wss://relay.damus.io/ 503
C3 | 12746 | 12742 | 12583 | 0 | loading world assets | wss://relay.damus.io/ 503
C4 | 24228 | 24223 | 24059 | 0 | loading world assets | no relay error logged
C5 | 13171 | 13167 | 13013 | 0 | loading world assets | no relay error logged
All loads: status read "joined" by the ~70 s sample. The 15 s stall message was not sampled; splat exceeded 15 s only in C4 (24.1 s). Relay 503 (C2, C3) did not track splat duration (C2 10.2 s, C4 24.1 s with no error), so the relay is not the gate. Splat await is the gate. Earlier runs with several tabs open (same room, peers 10) gave splat 41 s or more and are excluded as contaminated.
Logpoint line numbers (0-based CDP): build3d start 2171, splat await 2192 to 2195, unitFitsReady await 2199 to 2202, build3d end 2215, main await 2742 to 2744.

drain-lobby-relay-1-timing: lazy-world scratch (/tmp/drain-t2-x9R0mO/oscraft: build3d not awaited in main, drawWorld3d gated on splat). 3 loads, 1280x720, cache disabled, real relay. Scratch serves js/client/pkg and scenarios/moba/moba.osdt via 302 to the live Pages site (pkg was not copied: the fetch port returns binary as escaped text). Results:
Load | lobby buttons (Claim, Fill with bots, Start match) mount | status at mount | world ready (status local preview) | relay (console)
P3 | 4130 ms | joined | 5575 ms | wss://relay.damus.io 503
P4 | 3989 ms | joined | 5692 ms | no relay error logged
P5 | 7658 ms | joined | 8798 ms | wss://relay.damus.io 503
Verdict: the buttons mount before the world is ready (about 1.1 to 1.7 s earlier in these loads), but NOT while the status reads loading. The status history is connecting, then joined, then local preview; the loading text is overwritten in the same task, so no sample ever read it. No errors in the console (0 across the 3 loads). The start path is not gated in this scratch: local ticks run before the world is ready and Start match is clickable at mount. Gating needs the match-start path wired to the world-ready promise, which is not done here.
Origin comparison (earlier live-site loads, C1 to C5): buttons mount only after build3d ends, at 10 to 24 s after main's await starts.

material.subject: Lobby Fill with bots and Start match stay disabled when one Nostr relay returns 503
material.witness: Live witness verify-lobby-relay-1-fixed-b (session recorded in .gm/exec-spool/.dispatch-ledger.json line 5191) on https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html?host=1 at sha 7f68d3bcc7c7356b1291ccec7eda0b23ad2a89f2 (version.json matched). Claim 1: lobby buttons in DOM before world ready and before the 15 s stall. Claim 2: Start disabled and labelled loading world assets until world ready. Claim 3: label flips to Start match at world ready, Start disabled at 9/10 ready, enabled at 10/10 ready. Claim 4: match starts after Start click. Impl publish sha 7f68d3bcc7c7356b1291ccec7eda0b23ad2a89f2, CI 6/6 success, Pages run 40128978850 success. Screenshots .gm/witness/verify-lobby-relay-1-fixed-b-*.png.
material.witness_plan: In the browser, block relay.damus.io, then run Claim, Fill with bots, pick, Ready, Start match at 1280 by 720 and confirm the match starts. Run from a session other than the resolver.

witness_request.note: Gate: buildSplat texture loads inside build3d (live timings C1-C5, 10.2-24.1 s, prd-note dispatch 1792871329132-5152-edc260b58d28747a). The relay is not causal: the 503 loads were not slower, and stalls occur with the relay open. Lazy-world candidate (prd-note dispatch 1792871864438-5193-7e72f9ac3c1b9a05) mounts Claim/Fill/Start at 4.0-7.7 s, before the world is ready, but Start match is clickable with no gate. Blocking fact: start gating is not implemented, so the candidate is not publishable. Next: gate match start on the world-ready promise, publish via the temp-index route (play.js has foreign hunks at 503-530, 1142, 1935-1960), read CI, then witness from a separate session on the live Pages site. Relay symptom filed as relay-503-not-dropped-from-pool.
